title: carex scopulorum var. bracteosa
intro: Carex scopulorum var. bracteosa, commonly known as Bracted Sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Bracted Sedge are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
